test_title: PYST 16: Selection Post (GraduatiOn Level) - English (Held On 27 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in reported speech.

The teacher said, “She had started the fight”.

options.text: The teacher complained that she has started the fight.
The teacher said that she had started the fight.
The teacher ordered that she had started the fight,
The teacher said that she has started the fight.

solution:
The correct answer is “**The teacher said that she had started the fight.”**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• This option accurately converts the direct speech into reported speech without changing the tense of the original action verb "had started," which is already in past perfect and should remain unchanged in reported speech.
 
• It maintains the original statement's integrity by correctly attributing the action (starting the fight) to the same subject without misinterpreting or adding unintended connotations like "complained" or “ordered”.
 
• The sentence structure is a direct application of the rules of changing direct speech into indirect (reported) speech, showing that when the reporting verb is in the past tense, the tense of the direct statement usually does not change if it is already in a past form.
 
• By choosing "said" as the reporting verb, the sentence preserves the neutrality of the original statement without implying any additional attitude or emotion.

Hence, the correct answer is ‘**Option 2’.**
